articles.title: A Volcano Buried This Mountain Range 22 Million Years Ago — And Saved a Snapshot!
articles.summary: Imagine a volcano so big it buried a whole mountain range under ash. Scientists in Chile studied rocks from 22 million years ago and found the Andes grew slowly, like a plant, not in one big burst.

articles.title: Stephen Colbert's Show Wins Big at the Emmys — And Says Goodbye in Style
articles.summary: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert won six Emmys for its final season, the most ever. A new comedy called Widow's Bay broke records with 14 wins. Mariska Hargitay hosted and even sang parodies!

articles.title: From Small Tournaments to Davis Cup: Toby Samuel's 'Surreal' Year
articles.summary: Toby Samuel, 23, went from playing small tennis matches to representing Great Britain in the Davis Cup. He also played in three Grand Slams this year. He says it's been 'surreal.'
